title: Tech Note: The Object Name Property

historical_commentary.text: Object Names proved to be a durable and important feature in 4D form design. The ability to reference objects independently from their variable names has been carried forward through all subsequent versions and remains a core part of form programming in modern 4D, including in the JSON-based form definitions used in Project Mode.
related_updates: Object names remain a core feature of 4D form design in current versions
